messages.subject: Sutherland — independent business review scope
messages.plaintextBody:
Duncan, Aisha,

Following the introductions, can we confirm scope for the IBR for Sterling? The Bank will want: trading and EBITDA bridge FY23–FY26, a 13-week cashflow, the turnaround plan with sensitivities, and an estimated outcome statement (going concern vs administration). Target delivery to the Bank by 13 March.

Lesley will set you up with management accounts and the contract pipeline today.

Thanks,
Elena Marchetti
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0534

messages.snippet: Elena, Scope noted and agreed. We will run the 13-week cashflow weekly and refresh the model as the
messages.subject: RE: Sutherland — independent business review scope
messages.plaintextBody:
Elena,

Scope noted and agreed. We will run the 13-week cashflow weekly and refresh the model as the replacement contracts firm up. First read on liquidity: the late-April trough is real — without new money the RCF headroom looks exhausted in the week of 21 April. That strengthens the case for a modest super-senior tranche.

We'll have a draft IBR to you for comment by 9 March.

Aisha Chowdhury
Director, Restructuring Advisory | Marlow Tax & Advisory Ltd
